site.name: smc1-socket1
site.notes: Intel Xeon Platinum 8462Y+, 2 sockets. The benchmark uses 5 whole cores of socket 1 (harness 48-51 with SMT siblings 112-115, runner and mock 52 with 116); the rest of socket 1 is idle during the run (the release sweep is stopped); socket 0 runs unrelated development work and falcon-sensor. Governor performance, min = max 2.8 GHz, turbo off and C1E/C6 off on the benchmark cores for the run.

reasons: adaptive stopping: 2 of 2 cells stopped with fewer than 12 rounds (8-8) because their answer was clear; the 12-round minimum applies to the Verified badge
3 samples waited for the host to quiet down (longest 2 s) and 0 gave up waiting
